name: Slice 1: Dock outliner and details on the right, panel toggles and shortcuts
body:
# Slice 1: dock and panel toggles

The outliner and the inspector (details) stack on the right; the viewport fills the centre; the content drawer (assets,
console, history) sits under the viewport. `EditorLayout` holds a visible flag per panel (outliner, details, drawer), kept
in the preferences. Shortcuts: Alt+1 outliner, Alt+2 details, Alt+3 content drawer, Ctrl+Space content drawer, ` console,
F11 hides every panel for a clean viewport. The Window menu lists each panel with a check and its shortcut, and the
command palette gets the same commands.
